profile.headline: iOS Engineer at Meta
profile.summary: Give me a target and I'll find a way to hit it! Building software excites me and I love solving problems. I'm passionate about helping people get the result they are looking for and enjoy the process while they're at it! Quality is important to me and when it comes to achieving a goal I am determined to find a way as quickly as possible. From selling things on the playground as a kid to founding my own start-up, I have an entrepreneurial mindset and care about increasing the bottom line. I have a proven track record of getting results across a wide variety of projects, technologies and clients. Let's chat about the goals I can achieve for you!

positions.title: Senior iOS Engineer
positions.description:
• Automated build workflow for white-label car sharing platform, saving 3 hours of developer time per client per app version
• Enabled non-engineers to create and modify client apps by migrating configuration to a database and providing a web app, reducing the number of engineering tickets by 18%
• Rebuilt car sharing platform in Flutter as a proof of concept which led to an internal test of a new service concept with direct cofounder involvement
• Contributed to 28 app updates in over 500 pull requests and over 1,000 commits

positions.title: Senior Mobile Apps Developer
positions.description:
•	Fixed, enhanced and migrated app suite (iPad, Desktop, Web, API) to Azure. Shipped 3 more versions, starting solo and eventually leading a small team (C#, .NET, Objective C)
•	Delivered 36 app updates on iOS and Android (Native, Xamarin, Adobe Air, Cordova)
•	Built test runner to execute automated UI tests on remote devices and designed a toolchain to integrate execution and results with TFS (Appium, Selenium, Ruby)

positions.title: Apps Manager
positions.description:
• Delivered 10 mobile apps with responsibilities including quotation, app design, technical specification writing, development, testing and deployment
• Updated and maintained 15 slot games available on iOS and Facebook
• Vetted, hired, trained and led a junior apps developer

positions.title: Mobile Developer
positions.description: • Delivered 5 commercial iOS apps to spec with provided graphics using a variety of technologies (Objective C, CoreData, MapKit, SQLite, AWS, SOAP, YAML)

positions.title: Founder, Mobile Game Developer
positions.description:
• Released 4 commercial iOS games in 2010 (StarHunt, EggHunt!, Flingy, Munch it!)
• Led and managed small games development team, solely responsible for all development
• Built automated tool to export images from 3DS Max to Myst-style game

positions.title: Game Developer
positions.description:
• Main developer on a 3D game demo which was presented to Nintendo, Disney, Capcom, and Namco
• Coded game logic, enemy AI, Lua scripting integration, and mesh editing algorithms in C++ with Direct X in a 4-person team

educations.degreeName: Bachelor of Interactive Entertainment in Computer Science
